description: Land Acquisition - Pothuwewa, Mahawa D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired by the government for a naval training camp and armory, including location details, lot numbers, land names, claimants, and extents. The content focuses solely on land/property matters without any government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other administrative matters that would fall under other categories.
